fields.summary: CSV import skips rows with Unicode characters
fields.description:
When importing a CSV file containing Unicode characters (e.g. accented letters, CJK characters, emoji), rows with those characters are silently skipped. The importer appears to be using ASCII-only parsing.

Affects users in non-English locales significantly.

comments.body: Reproduced with a file containing Japanese characters. 40% of rows were skipped.
